mapper.select: SELECT m.member_id, m.member_name, m.grade, m.phone, m.created_at FROM MEMBERS m WHERE m.del_yn = 'N' ORDER BY m.member_id
SELECT m.member_id, m.member_name, m.grade, m.phone, m.created_at FROM MEMBERS m WHERE m.del_yn = 'N' AND m.member_id = #{memberId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO MEMBERS (member_id, member_name, grade, email, phone, phone_norm, password_hash, marketing_opt_in, created_at) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{memberName}, #{grade}, #{email}, #{phone}, #{phoneNorm}, #{passwordHash}, #{marketingOptIn}, #{createdAt})
INSERT INTO ID_SEQUENCES (name, next_val) VALUES ('MEMBER_ID', LAST_INSERT_ID(1)) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE next_val = LAST_INSERT_ID(next_val + 1)
mapper.select: SELECT member_id FROM MEMBERS WHERE del_yn = 'N' AND (LOWER(email) = #{email} OR phone_norm = #{phoneNorm}) LIMIT 1
